lines.text: An unmarked box in the corner. Nobody is watching. Inside: a stack of printed manifestos from 2010.

card.title: 2010 vs 2025,  Infrastructure Section
card.left_text: The rehabilitation of the Alupotha main road connecting the market junction to the Grama Sevaka Office will be completed within the next term.
card.right_text: The rehabilitation of the Alupotha main road connecting the market junction to the Grama Sevaka Office remains a priority for our administration.
card.difference_note: 94% identical. Only change: 'will be completed within the next term' → 'remains a priority'.

lines.text: The game says nothing about this comparison. It just shows it.
